documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligation And Disclosure Requirements) 2015- Proposed Execution Of Business Transfer Agreement (BTA) With M/S. Magnumtuff India Private Limited

analysis.summary: Sejal Glass Limited reported its Q2 and H1 FY27 financial and operational performance, highlighting strong growth in revenue and profitability driven by improved capacity utilization across manufacturing facilities in Silvassa, Taloja, Erode, and UAE. Management discussed ongoing strategic initiatives including the expansion of specialized and value-added product offerings such as fire-rated glass, bullet-resin glass, digital printed glass, and railway-grade glass. The company maintained a constructive outlook for FY27, targeting revenue growth between 25% and 40% alongside stable EBITDA and PAT margins. Additionally, management highlighted robust order inflows across both domestic and international markets. Sejal Glass Limited released its investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, reporting consolidated revenue from operations of ₹138.09 crore and an EBITDA margin of 18.35% for Q2 FY27.

guidance.claim: Management expects year-on-year revenue growth in the range of 25% to 40% for FY27.
guidance.quote: Based on our assessment of market condition, real estate activity, infrastructure development, and progress of our operations, we continue to expect year-on-year revenue growth in the range of 25% to 40%.

guidance.claim: The company remains focused on sustaining EBITDA margin at around 18% and maintaining a PAT margin of approximately 10%.
guidance.quote: We also remain focused on sustaining EBITDA margin at around 18% and maintaining a PAT margin of approximate 10%.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates revenue growth between 25% and 40% by year-end.
guidance.quote: Yes, we are expecting between 25% to 40% by year-end.

guidance.claim: Specialty products are expected to contribute 5% this year and 15% to 20% next year.
guidance.quote: We are expecting 5% in this year from the value-added products and next year 15% or 20%.

guidance.claim: Management targets revenue growth of minimum 25% with an upside potential of 40% for FY27.
guidance.quote: Based on our current order book and execution pipeline, we see potential upside of our initial FY27 revenue growth guidance of around 25% or more.

guidance.claim: The company expects PAT margins of nearly 9% to 10% for the current financial year FY27.
guidance.quote: So, nearly 9% PAT we are expecting this year, FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects improved capacity utilization across facilities and a more balanced contribution from India and the UAE to support sustainable growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Going forward, we expect improved capacity utilization across our facility and a more balanced contribution from India and the UAE to support sustainable growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The UAE order book provides visibility for execution over the following 6 to 9 months.
demand_outlook.quote: Our UAE order book reached approximately AED78 million in September 2026, providing visibility for execution over the following 6 to 9 months.

demand_outlook.claim: Real estate, healthcare, airports, infrastructure, and defense are seen as promising opportunities for fire-rated glass applications.
demand_outlook.quote: We see promising opportunity across real estate, healthcare, airports, infrastructure, defense and other applications where fire safety requirement are important.

demand_outlook.claim: UAE construction output is forecast at AED 189.6 billion for 2026, representing a 6.2% increase.
demand_outlook.quote: AED 189.6 Bn UAE construction output forecast for 2026, +6.2%

demand_outlook.claim: UAE construction CAGR is forecast at 4.8% for 2026-2030.
Upcoming GCC projects are valued at USD 2.0 trillion.
demand_outlook.quote: USD 2.0 Tn Upcoming GCC projects; Saudi ~50%, UAE 27.5%

demand_outlook.claim: The long-term outlook for the architectural glass industry remains encouraging due to investments in premium residential, commercial infrastructure, and energy-efficient buildings.
demand_outlook.quote: The long-term outlook for the architectural glass industry continues to remain encouraging, supported by increasing investment in premium residential development, commercial infrastructure, and energy-efficient buildings.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the UAE situation is improving and getting stabilized from geopolitical situations.
demand_outlook.quote: And secondly, in last-to-last interview, I told that, you know, the UAE situation is now in a better situation, though yet, you know, something is happening on the geopolitical situations. Once situation will be stabilized, then we are, hopeful that we will, reach up to 40%.

capex_expansion.claim: The manufacturing line and associated technology for fire-rated glass have been imported and are being installed at the factory facility.
capex_expansion.quote: The manufacturing line and associate technology has been imported and are being installed at our factory facility, with the trial production and approval progress towards the commercial production targeted to end of Q3 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The remaining capex requirement for the UAE tempering and fire-rated glass line is in the range of AED20 million.
capex_expansion.quote: So, the tempering third line and the fire-rated and the other facilities to be required to make this operation is around in the range of AED20 million of our total investment in terms of capex.

capex_expansion.claim: In UAE, the total capex of around AED15 million includes the third tempering line and fire-rated technology.
capex_expansion.quote: Around AED15 million is the total capex for in UAE, including the third line and fire-rated.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production for the third tempering line and fire-rated technology in UAE is expected to start in Q3.
capex_expansion.quote: So, in Q3, we are expecting to start the commercial production, and fire-rated technology, which has also been installed at UAE, that also we are expecting to start commercial production in Q3 end.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved to 18.35% from 17.03% in Q2 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved to 18.35% from 17.03%, representing the expansion of 132 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Net profit margin improved to 10.31% from 7.73% in Q2 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: The net profit margin improved to 10.31% from 7.73%, an expansion of 258 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Fire-rated glass is a very value-added product with an EBITDA margin of more than 30%.
margins_costs.quote: Margins will be definitely more in terms of EBITDA, it is more than 30%, because it is a very value-added product.

margins_costs.claim: Erode achieved EBITDA breakeven by March 2026.
Consolidated EBITDA increased by over 44% year-on-year to INR18 crores, and PAT grew by more than 63% year-on-year to INR7.22 crores.
margins_costs.quote: This robust revenue growth translated into a healthy profitability with consolidated EBITDA increasing by over 44% year-on-year to INR18 crores, and consolidated profit after tax growing by more than 63% year-on-year to INR7.22 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Performance appraisal, yearly increments, and the signing of a labor union agreement at the Taloja plant created an incremental impact of around INR1 crore on people cost in the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: See, in this quarter, there is a performance appraisal and yearly increment, number 1, and number 2, there was a signature of our labor union agreement, which is in Taloja plant. So, there is an incremental around INR1 crores impact of the people cost in this quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Higher operating volumes are expected to improve fixed cost absorptions and support an EBITDA margin improvement of approximately 1% over upcoming quarters.
margins_costs.quote: Higher operating volumes are expected to improve fixed cost absorptions and support an improvement in EBITDA margin of approximately 1% over the upcoming quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: The annual production capacity across all products put together is approximately 61.94 lakh square meters.
orders_capacity.quote: We now have four state-of-the-art along with our manufacturing plant network with an annual production capacity of approximately 61.94 lakh square meters for all products put together that is, tempered, laminated and insulated glasses.

orders_capacity.claim: In July 2026, the UAE subsidiary secured five architectural glass orders aggregating approximately AED27.6 million.
orders_capacity.quote: In July 2026, our UAE subsidiary secured five significant architectural glass orders, aggregating approximate AED27.6 million, equivalent to around INR71 crores, for hospitality, residential and healthcare projects.

orders_capacity.claim: Domestic architectural glass projects aggregating approximately INR150 crores were secured across commercial, residential, and institutional applications.
orders_capacity.quote: In addition, we secured domestic architectural glass projects, aggregating approximately INR150 crores across commercial, residential and institutional applications.

orders_capacity.claim: The UAE order book reached approximately AED78 million in September 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our UAE order book reached approximately AED78 million in September 2026, providing visibility for execution over the following 6 to 9 months.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book for the India business is around INR85 crores.
The India business secured orders exceeding INR50 crores from leading developers like Godrej, L&T, Prestige, and Raheja.
orders_capacity.quote: Our India business also witnessed a healthy order inflow during the quarter, securing orders exceeding INR50 crores from leading developers such as Godrej, L&T, Prestige, and Raheja, with execution planned over the next 6 months.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization stands at around 77% in Silvassa, 55% in Taloja, 15% in Erode, and 71% in the UAE plant for base tempering.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity-wise, see, our Silvassa plant is at around 77%, and Taloja is already at 55%, Erode is around 15%, and our UAE plant is around 71%, as we are talking on a tempering capacity utilization, which is our base product line.

capital_allocation.claim: Long-term debts from banks are paid on an EMI system regularly with no current prepayment plans.
capital_allocation.quote: As of now, the debts are more of like long-term debts from the banks, which are being paid on EMI system regularly. So right now, as such, nothing on that front to reduce debt or making a prepayments to the bankers.

capital_allocation.claim: Capex funding is planned roughly 60% from internal accruals and 40% from banking finance.
capital_allocation.quote: From internal accruals to certain extent, and to certain extent we will be looking for a banking finance also. So, in the range of more or less 60:40, 60% from our internal accruals, 40% from our banking finance.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt to EBITDA is reported at 2.0x, and Debt to Equity has reduced to 1.09x.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt/Equity reduced to 1.09x; Net Debt/EBITDA at 2.0x; ₹51 Cr operating cash flow

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash flow for FY26 was ₹51.04 crore.
The company stated it does not have any fund-raising plans for capex.
capital_allocation.quote: We don’t have any fund raising plan. Whatever the capex planning is there, which is within the internal profit and second, little bit of debt.

capital_allocation.claim: The present debt in India is around INR52 crores, comprising INR14 crores of working capital debt and INR38 crores of term loans.
capital_allocation.quote: The present debt in India is around INR52 crores, which includes the working capital debt also of around INR14 crores, and the term loan is of around INR38 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East led to some increase in shipment and logistic costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Of course, there is an increase in cost of some of the things because of logistic cost as shipment cost has been increased.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantee of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

risks_headwinds.claim: Risks and uncertainties include the performance of the Indian economy and international markets, competition, and implementation of strategies.
risks_headwinds.quote: These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, the performance of the Indian economy and of the economies of various international markets, the performance of the industry in India and world-wide, competition, the company’s ability to successfully implement its strategy

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that geopolitical situations caused minor disruptions in UAE logistics during June.
risks_headwinds.quote: And also, there in June due to war, little bit of disturbance in UAE on logistics. So little bit of hit on the logistics cost also.

management_commitments.claim: Trial production and approvals for fire-rated glass are targeted toward the end of Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: with the trial production and approval progress towards the commercial production targeted to end of Q3 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Execution of the UAE order book is expected to continue over the next two quarters.
management_commitments.quote: Execution of these projects commenced during June and July, and it is expected to continue over the next two quarters, providing stronger revenue visibility.

management_commitments.claim: Execution of orders exceeding INR50 crores in India is planned over the next 6 months.
management_commitments.quote: Our India business also witnessed a healthy order inflow during the quarter, securing orders exceeding INR50 crores from leading developers such as Godrej, L&T, Prestige, and Raheja, with execution planned over the next 6 months.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets reaching 85% to 90% utilization in Silvassa, 75% in Taloja, 25% to 30% in Erode, and 85% in UAE by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: So Silvassa, we are expecting by year end we will be reaching at 85% to 90%. Taloja, we are expecting to reach at 75% in the next quarters. Erode, yes, we will target of around 25% to 30% in the next quarters. And UAE, we are already at 71%, so we are targeting to reach at 85% as we are already adding a third line of tempering.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial production for the third tempering line and fire-rated technology in the UAE is expected to start in Q3.
management_commitments.quote: So, in Q3, we are expecting to start the commercial production, and fire-rated technology, which has also been installed at UAE, that also we are expecting to start commercial production in Q3 end.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets 10% of revenue to come from new verticals like railway glass and fire products next year.
management_commitments.quote: Next, we are targeting 10% of the revenue will come from that vertical.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
